title: Horseness is the whatness of allhorse
html_source: Plato would have us believe that seeing a horse isn’t the universal truth of what a horse is. Aristotle was more scientific in his theory of light deducing light travelled from the object through a medium to the eye. Stephen is having to steer between this philosophical Scylla and Charybdis
